author: "Djeneba Kounta"
output: html_document

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

salaries  <- read_csv("salaries_clean.csv")
rent      <- read_csv("rent_clean.csv")
self_suff <- read_csv("self_sufficiency.csv")
```

# 1. Employee Salaries

```{r}
# Summary of base salary
summary(salaries$base_salary)
```

```{r}
# Distribution of base salary
ggplot(salaries, aes(x = base_salary)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#00BFC4", color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(scale = 1/1000, suffix = "k")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Base Salary", x = "Base Salary", y = "Number of Employees")
```

```{r}
# Average base salary by gender
salaries |>
  group_by(gender) |>
  summarise(employees = n(), average_salary = mean(base_salary))

ggplot(salaries, aes(x = gender, y = base_salary, fill = gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(scale = 1/1000, suffix = "k")) +
  labs(title = "Base Salary by Gender", x = "Gender", y = "Base Salary")
```

```{r}
# Average base salary for the 10 largest departments
top_departments <- salaries |>
  group_by(department_name) |>
  summarise(employees = n(), average_salary = mean(base_salary)) |>
  slice_max(employees, n = 10)

top_departments

ggplot(top_departments, aes(x = reorder(department_name, average_salary), y = average_salary, fill = department_name)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(scale = 1/1000, suffix = "k")) +
  labs(title = "Average Base Salary in the 10 Largest Departments", x = "", y = "Average Base Salary")
```

# 2. Rent

```{r}
# Summary of monthly rent
summary(rent$rent)
```

```{r}
# Median monthly rent by bedroom type
rent_by_bedroom <- rent |>
  group_by(bedroom_type) |>
  summarise(units = n(), median_rent = median(rent))

rent_by_bedroom

ggplot(rent, aes(x = bedroom_type, y = rent, fill = bedroom_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Rent by Bedroom Type", x = "Bedroom Type", y = "Monthly Rent")
```

# 3. Self-Sufficiency Standard

```{r}
self_suff

# Minimum annual salary needed by family type
ggplot(self_suff, aes(x = reorder(family_type, annual_wage), y = annual_wage, fill = family_type)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(scale = 1/1000, suffix = "k")) +
  labs(title = "Minimum Annual Salary Needed in Montgomery County (2023)", x = "", y = "Annual Self-Sufficiency Wage")
```

```{r}
# Monthly costs by family type
self_suff |>
  select(family_type, housing, child_care, food, transportation, health_care, taxes) |>
  pivot_longer(-family_type, names_to = "cost", values_to = "amount") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = family_type, y = amount, fill = cost)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Costs by Family Type", x = "", y = "Monthly Cost", fill = "Cost")
```
